result:
If it were truly my choice, I’d eliminate the ease with which people can dehumanize one another.

Not because disagreement would vanish, but because so much cruelty, exploitation, and indifference depends on seeing other people as less real, less feeling, or less deserving. If that mental door were harder to walk through, a lot of the world’s worst patterns would lose their fuel.
